tool_calls.arguments: {"layout":"landscape","prompt":"Create a clean, simple bar chart for a presentation slide (landscape). Four vertical bars labeled Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 with values: Q1 = 1.2, Q2 = 1.9, Q3 = 1.7, Q4 = 2.4. Units: Millions USD — include y-axis label 'Millions USD'. Use a plain, professional style: white background, no gradients, no drop shadows, no textures. Bars should be flat solid color (single muted blue) with thin black or dark gray outlines optional. Include y-axis ticks and labels at 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5 (or appropriate gridlines) so values are clear. Add value labels above each bar (1.2, 1.9, 1.7, 2.4). Use a clear sans-serif font, readable at slide resolution. Keep margins suitable for slide (title area optional but not required). Do not include logos, gradients, or decorative elements. Export as a high-resolution image suitable for a presentation slide."}
tool_calls.name: image_generate
